create_plot_run: create an interactive plotly figure from Torax simulation output files with configurable subplots
create_plot_run_from_data_tree: create an interactive plotly figure from in-memory xarray DataTrees for comparing multiple Torax runs
create_plot_data: create a PlotData object from an xarray DataTree to access Torax simulation variables as attributes
create_figure_properties: create a FigureProperties configuration defining subplot grid layout and styling for Torax plots
create_plot_properties: create a PlotProperties configuration defining attributes, labels, and plot type for an individual subplot
